what_agents_must_know: He writes code from 30 years of experience, not tutorials
He does not use frameworks, foreign keys, or database logic
He prioritizes portability (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite) over vendor lock-in
He expects agents to READ files, not GUESS
He will hand-type code if AI refuses to write it correctly
He built a session system with Class C IP + User Agent that works on mobile
He does not trust REMOTE_ADDR — use resolvedClientIp() with proxy headers
He separates 'when' from 'where' — never mix time and location
